basic_details.job_title: TFRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Project Fellow, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICFRE-Tropical Forest Research Institute (ICFRE-TFRI), Jabalpur, needs one Junior Project Fellow (JPF) and one Project Assistant. The pay is a fixed Rs. 24,000/- for the Junior Project Fellow and a fixed Rs. 22,000/- for the Project Assistant, both without HRA. Both posts are purely temporary and end when their research project ends. Candidates must email their complete CV and self-attested copies of all relevant documents by 26 October 2026, with the name of the project in the subject line.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 1 June 2026. The notice gives this one limit for both posts and does not print a minimum age. Candidates who are Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes, Women, Divyangjan or OBC applicants get a relaxation of up to 5 years. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: Preference will be given to candidates with basic computer knowledge and 2 years of experience in Agroforestry.

Write the name of the project in the email subject line.
Page 2 of the notice has a "Proforma for Application". It asks for these details:

Educational qualification: year of passing, subject, degree, institute/university and % marks

A signed declaration that the information is true. The applicant accepts that any false or incorrect information will make them responsible for their termination. Add the date, place, and your name and signature.

content_sections.heading: About ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: ICFRE-Tropical Forest Research Institute (ICFRE-TFRI) is a forest research institute. Its address is P.O.-R.F.R.C., Mandla Road, Jabalpur-482021, Madhya Pradesh. Both posts are on research projects led by ICFRE-TFRI scientists. One project is in the SFM&FM Division and the other is in the Silviculture and Forest Management Division.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 vacancies, one for each post. Each post is on its own project with its own Principal Investigator (P.I.). The Junior Project Fellow project is led by Dr. Nanita Berry, Scientist-F and PI, SFM&FM Division (email: [email protected] ). The Project Assistant project is led by Dr. Hariom Saxena, Scientist-E and PI, Silviculture and Forest Management Division (email: [email protected] ). rows.project: "Development of Food Forest for food and livelihood security of farmers in selected agro-climatic zones of Madhya Pradesh" (ID No. 305/MPSFD)
"Detailed Study cum Survey to Assess the Demand & Supply of Medicinal Plants and their Raw Material at National Level including Global Perspective"

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to candidates with basic computer knowledge and 2 years of experience in Agroforestry. Candidates with a higher degree and experience will be preferred. Experience in household surveys and in primary and secondary data collection on medicinal plants. Taxonomic knowledge of medicinal plants. Efficient in computer work (MS Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint etc.). The upper age limit is 28 years as on 1 June 2026. The notice gives this one limit for both posts and does not print a minimum age. Candidates who are Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes, Women, Divyangjan or OBC applicants get a relaxation of up to 5 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: 1st class M.Sc. in Agroforestry/ Forestry/Botany/ Chemistry / Zoology/Agriculture
1st class Graduate degree in Forestry /Agriculture/Life Sciences/Social Sciences (Sociology, Economics, Social work)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Project Fellow gets Rs. 24,000/- fixed and the Project Assistant gets Rs. 22,000/- fixed. The notice says both amounts are without HRA. Both posts are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The JPF project runs for 2025-29 and the Project Assistant project runs for 06 months. Appointment will be made subject to receipt of budget or availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email only. The notice does not describe an online portal. Prepare your complete CV. Keep self-attested copies of all relevant documents ready. Email your CV and the documents to the email ID printed against your post's project: [email protected] for the Junior Project Fellow post, or [email protected] for the Project Assistant post. Write the name of the project in the email subject line. Send the email by 26 October 2026. Page 2 of the notice has a "Proforma for Application". It asks for these details: A recent photograph pasted in the space given Project title and name of the post applied for Name of the applicant and father's/husband's name Date of birth and age as on 01/06/2026 Category Address for correspondence (with PIN code), mobile number and email ID Educational qualification: year of passing, subject, degree, institute/university and % marks Experience, if any A signed declaration that the information is true.
